source.search_anchor: Code search at the same pinned commit located TransactionAbortStrategyContextImpl construction in ExactlyOnceKafkaWriter; the full pinned writer source was then fetched.
observed_operations: ExactlyOnceKafkaWriter documents transactionAbortStrategy as aborting lingering transactions from previous executions during writer initialization.
initialize() directly calls abortLingeringTransactions(recoveredStates, restoredCheckpointId + 1) before starting the first new transaction.
abortLingeringTransactions builds TransactionAbortStrategyContextImpl and then directly invokes transactionAbortStrategy.abortTransactions(context).

snapshotState(checkpointId) polls the committer backchannel, captures ongoing transactions, starts the next transaction, and returns snapshots; in this source it does not call abortLingeringTransactions or transactionAbortStrategy.abortTransactions.
No periodic timer/scheduler/background loop in ExactlyOnceKafkaWriter invokes abortLingeringTransactions after initialization in the inspected file.

finding.summary: At pinned apache/flink-connector-kafka commit dc707db60fcf3c0637114503c27685c881519c2c, the immediate writer-side trigger for TransactionAbortStrategy abort inspection is ExactlyOnceKafkaWriter.initialize(): initialization calls abortLingeringTransactions, constructs the strategy context, and synchronously invokes abortTransactions before starting the first transaction. The inspected writer source does not show a periodic or autonomous re-invocation of this abort-inspection path during later checkpoint snapshots.
finding.falsifying_trace: If writer initialization is never entered, this inspected writer file contains no timer/scheduler/background loop that independently calls abortLingeringTransactions. When initialize() is entered, abortLingeringTransactions runs before startTransaction(restoredCheckpointId + 1); snapshotState later starts the next transaction but does not invoke the abort strategy in this file.
finding.scope_guard: ExactlyOnceKafkaWriter.java only at commit dc707db60fcf3c0637114503c27685c881519c2c. This does not claim TransactionAbortStrategyImpl never calls AdminUtils conditionally, does not cover Flink runtime decisions about when initialize() runs, Kafka Admin internals, broker transaction expiry, other writers, or autonomous behavior outside this file.
